sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Muskegon State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483548: /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for the Lake Michigan North Loop and South Loop maps, 2026-10-27, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-13, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-10-26; read 2026-10-25)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site: in season $48 a night for 20/30-amp sites and $53 for the 24 North Loop sites with 50-amp service (2027-05-18, 07-13); off-season semi-modern rates $43 / $48 (2027-10-26), and $40 / $45 through mid-April 2027. 2026 in season: $45 / $50 (DNR rates table; semi-modern $40 / $45). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Lake Michigan North Loop sites A1 (fee schedule -32687) and A18 (fee schedule -32688, 50-amp): $48 / $53 for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13, $43 / $48 for 2027-10-26, $40 / $45 for 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-04-13) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Muskegon, Lake Michigan Campground: Modern 50 AMP $50, 20/30 AMP $45; Semi-modern 50 AMP $45, 20/30 AMP or toilets $40), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The South Loop closes October 21; the toilet/shower building is open April 22 to October 21 (vault toilets otherwise), and campground water runs only late April to mid-October.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Muskegon Lake Michigan Campground: 'The modern campground, divided into two loops and open year-round for camping'; Mini Cabins: 'The is potable water available in the campground (late April to mid October); however, you must provide your own water in the off-season.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Lake Michigan Campground: modern toilet/shower building 'April 22 to Oct. 21'; Yurt row: 'The Lake Michigan south loop closes on Oct 21.'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (all 103 Lake Michigan campsites: 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 24 North Loop sites list 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Lake Michigan Campground tags 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 103 campsites on the booking site, 50 in the North Loop and 53 in the South Loop, plus two mini cabins and a yurt (the DNR page's 'Number of sites: 106' counts them). Many sites are small: 30 South Loop sites have no pad and take tents or truck campers only, and 38 more take rigs only up to 20 ft; about 32 take 25 ft or more (23 of them in the North Loop, where 3 take 50 ft). Two pull-throughs (A15, A43).

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Muskegon Lake Michigan Campground: 'Number of sites: 106'; tag 'Pull-through sites available'; Mini Cabins 'Number of sites: 2') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (maps 'Lake Michigan North Loop' 50 campsites + 2 mini cabins + 1 yurt and 'Lake Michigan South Loop' 53 campsites; per-site allowed equipment; site descriptions such as 'No pad. Tents or Pop-Up only on this site.'; 'Pull Through=Yes' on A15 and A43), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Toilet/shower building April 22 - October 21; vault toilets the rest of the year. A two-lane sanitation station with potable water is near both campgrounds.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Lake Michigan Campground tags 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet', 'Sanitation station'; 'A sanitation station is located near both campgrounds. There is potable water available and two lanes.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Lake Michigan Campground: modern toilet/shower building 'April 22 to Oct. 21'; Yurt row: 'All other times, vault toilets are available.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/muskegon (Muskegon Lake Michigan Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (103 bookable Lake Michigan campsites) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Muskegon, Lake Michigan Campground: reservation season 'Year-round' - 'Year-round'), read 2026-10-25

note: Mostly wooded modern campground in two loops on the far side of a large dune from Lake Michigan, with a stairway to the beach. --Claude
summary: Verified at its own pin (the Lake Michigan Campground, separate from 3634): DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table. Sites 105 -> 103 campsites (106 on the DNR page includes 2 mini cabins and a yurt), all electric, 50-amp at 24 (new), water false (confirmed) / sewer false (new), rigs to 50 ft but most sites small (30 tent/truck-camper only, 38 more up to 20 ft), 2 pull-throughs (new). Season year_round (new: 'open year-round for camping'), South Loop closes Oct 21, showers Apr 22 - Oct 21. Reservable on MiDNRReservations, reservation season year-round (confirmed, derived -> manual). Fees 40-50 -> 43-53 (2027 booking site: $48/$53 in season, $43/$48 semi-modern off-season). Phone 231-744-3480 matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
